csr.tx_payload

Absolute Address:

Description

DWORDs of the outgoing TLP from DW4 on: entry i is DW 3+i. DW3 is tx.data, written last to launch the transfer, so entry 0 is not sent. The TLP's Fmt and Length say how many entries go out.
